title.zh: Abracadabra提议以每美元四美分的价格清盘MIM
title.en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar

current_state.zh: Abracadabra 关停协议并清算 MIM 的 Snapshot 投票已开启，投票期为 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC 至 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC；已有赞成与反对票，提案称约 2100 万美元坏账、约 90 万美元可执行担保、MIM 有效支持低于 0.04 美元，并称 SPELL 价值清零。
current_state.en: The Abracadabra Snapshot vote to shut down the protocol and liquidate MIM is open from 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC to 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC; votes for and against have been cast; the proposal cites ~$21M bad debt, ~$900K executable collateral, sub-$0.04 effective MIM backing, and declares SPELL valueless.

updates.title_zh: Abracadabra提议以每美元四美分的价格清盘MIM
updates.title_en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
updates.what_changed_zh: Abracadabra已提议进行Snapshot投票以清算该协议，将剩余抵押品兑换为以太币并按比例支付给MIM持有者，而可回收的支持资产仅约90万美元，对应2100万美元的坏账——约为每美元四美分。
updates.what_changed_en: Abracadabra has proposed a Snapshot vote to liquidate the protocol, swap remaining collateral into ether and pay MIM holders pro rata, with only about $900,000 of recoverable backing against $21 million in bad debt — roughly four cents on the dollar.

updates.title_zh: 【Abracadabra 发起关停协议并清算 MIM 的提案投票，协议坏账约 2100 万美元】
updates.title_en: 【Abracadabra 发起关停协议并清算 MIM 的提案投票，协议坏账约 2100 万美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: Snapshot 投票已开启：投票于 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC 开始、2026-09-30 17:24 UTC 结束；已有两地址投票，一地址质押约 1 亿 SPELL 赞成，另一地址质押约 52.3 万 SPELL 反对；提案还称 SPELL 价值清零，MIM 债务优先级高于 SPELL。
updates.what_changed_en: The Snapshot vote is now open: it began 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC and ends 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC; two addresses have voted, one staking ~100M SPELL in favor and one staking ~523K SPELL against; the proposal also declares SPELL valueless and subordinate to MIM debt.
updates.current_state_zh: Abracadabra 关停协议并清算 MIM 的 Snapshot 投票已开启，投票期为 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC 至 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC；已有赞成与反对票，提案称约 2100 万美元坏账、约 90 万美元可执行担保、MIM 有效支持低于 0.04 美元，并称 SPELL 价值清零。
updates.current_state_en: The Abracadabra Snapshot vote to shut down the protocol and liquidate MIM is open from 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC to 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC; votes for and against have been cast; the proposal cites ~$21M bad debt, ~$900K executable collateral, sub-$0.04 effective MIM backing, and declares SPELL valueless.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Abracadabra has opened a Snapshot vote to shut down the protocol and liquidate MIM, disclosing about $21M in bad debt, only ~$900K in executable collateral and sub-$0.04 effective backing for the stablecoin, with SPELL declared valueless.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Abracadabra has opened a Snapshot vote to shut down the protocol and liquidate MIM, disclosing about $21M in bad debt, only ~$900K in executable collateral and sub-$0.04 effective backing for the stablecoin, with SPELL declared valueless.
